findings.description: The check `isinstance(filename, str)` was replaced with `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so plain `str` filenames are no longer wrapped in a tuple. `str` does not implement `os.PathLike`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `click.edit(filename="foo.txt")`. The string is passed unwrapped to `edit_files`, which iterates it character by character. The editor is then launched with one argument per character ("f", "o", "o", ...) instead of the file name. This breaks the most common usage. The condition should be `isinstance(filename, (str, os.PathLike))`.
